title: 2025 真题 Text 2 · 重新构想英国医疗体系
description: 从医院中心模式的局限出发，讨论社会健康因素和医疗资源的分配。
author: 2025 English Exam
heroNote: 抓住“增进国民健康”与“修补医疗机构”之间的视角差别。

sentences.en: When it was established, the National Health Service (NHS) was visionary: offering high-quality, timely care to meet the dominant needs of the population it served.
sentences.zhReference: 英国国家医疗服务体系刚建立时具有前瞻性：它及时提供优质医疗，满足当时人群的主要健康需求。

vocabulary.meaning: 英国国家医疗服务体系

sentences.en: Nearly 75 years on, with the UK facing very different health challenges, it is clear that model is out of date.
sentences.zhReference: 近七十五年过去了，英国如今面临截然不同的健康挑战，这一模式显然已经过时。

sentences.en: From life expectancy to cancer and infant mortality rates, we are lagging behind many of our peers.
sentences.zhReference: 从预期寿命到癌症和婴儿死亡率等指标，英国都落后于许多同类国家。

sentences.en: With more than 6.8 million on waitlists, healthcare is becoming increasingly inaccessible for those who cannot opt to pay for private treatment; and the cost of providing healthcare is increasingly squeezing out investment in other public services.
sentences.zhReference: 超过六百八十万人在等候名单上；对无力自费接受私人治疗的人来说，医疗服务越来越难获得，而且医疗费用正日益挤占其他公共服务的投资。

sentences.en: As demand for healthcare continues to grow, pressures on the workforce—which is already near breaking point—will only become more acute.
sentences.zhReference: 随着医疗需求持续增长，原已接近崩溃边缘的医护人员将面临更严峻的压力。

sentences.en: Many of the answers to the crisis in health and care are well rehearsed.
sentences.zhReference: 应对医疗与照护危机的许多办法早已被反复提及。

sentences.en: We need to be much better at reducing and diverting demand on health services, rather than simply managing it.
sentences.zhReference: 我们需要更有效地减少并分流对医疗服务的需求，而不是仅仅管理已有需求。

sentences.en: Much more needs to be invested in communities and primary care to reduce our reliance on hospitals.
sentences.zhReference: 应在社区和初级保健投入更多资金，减少对医院的依赖。

sentences.en: And capacity in social care needs to be greater, to support the growing number of people living with long-term conditions.
sentences.zhReference: 社会照护能力也需要加强，以支持越来越多患有长期疾病的人。

sentences.en: Yet despite two decades of strategies and a number of major health reforms, we have failed to make meaningful progress on any of these aims.
sentences.zhReference: 然而，经历了二十年的战略制定和多次重大医疗改革，我们在这些目标上都未取得实质进展。

sentences.en: That is why the Reform think tank is launching a new programme of work entitled “Reimagining health”, supported by ten former health ministers.
sentences.zhReference: 因此，获得十名前卫生大臣支持的改革智库正推出一项名为“重新构想健康”的新工作计划。

sentences.en: Together, we are calling for a much more open and honest conversation about the future of health in the UK, and an “urgent rethink” of the hospital-centric model we retain.
sentences.zhReference: 我们共同呼吁就英国医疗的未来展开更开放、诚实的讨论，并“紧急重新思考”目前仍维持的医院中心模式。

sentences.en: This must begin with the question of how we maximise the health of the nation, rather than “fix” the NHS.
sentences.zhReference: 首先要问的应该是如何最大限度增进国民健康，而不是如何“修补”国家医疗服务体系。

vocabulary.term: maximise the health of the nation
vocabulary.meaning: 最大限度提升国民健康

sentences.en: It is estimated, for example, that healthcare accounts for only about 20% of health outcomes.
sentences.zhReference: 例如，据估计，医疗服务对健康结果的贡献只有约百分之二十。

sentences.en: Much more important are the places we live, work and socialise—yet there is no clear cross-government strategy for improving these social determinants of health.
sentences.zhReference: 更重要的是我们生活、工作与社交的环境；然而，政府各部门并无明确的跨部门战略来改善这些健康的社会决定因素。

sentences.en: Worse, when policies like the national obesity strategy are scrapped, taxpayers are left with the heavy price tag of treating the illnesses, like diabetes, that result.
sentences.zhReference: 更糟的是，国家肥胖治理战略一类政策一旦被废除，纳税人就得承担治疗糖尿病等后续疾病的高昂费用。

sentences.en: Reform wants to ask how power and resources should be distributed in our health system.
sentences.zhReference: 改革智库希望提出一个问题：卫生系统中的权力与资源应如何分配？

sentences.en: What health functions should remain at the centre, and what should be given to local leaders, often responsible for services that create health, and with a much better understanding of the needs of their populations?
sentences.zhReference: 哪些卫生职能应留在中央，哪些应交由地方领导者负责？他们通常负责有助于促进健康的服务，也更了解本地居民的需求。
